info.title: API.SH: Komoot
info.description: The Komoot API from API.SH: public Komoot data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A public Komoot collection (a themed list of routes and highlights, often by a tourism board or brand): name, type, sport, tags, multi-day flag, intro, creator and its items (`item_type` tour or highlight, with the fields of `/komoot/v1/tour` or `/komoot/v1/highlight`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-collection

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A collection id or a komoot.com/collection/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Komoot highlight with its name, type, categories, intro, location and altitude, score, `popularity_by_month` (low/medium/high per month), creator, its top tips (`tips`: text, language, English translation, up and down votes, author, date; `tips_total`) and photos (`photos`; `photos_total`). Komoot shows a highlight's first 3 tips and 5 photos to visitors who are not logged in; the totals give the full counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-highlight

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A highlight id or a komoot.com/highlight/... link.

get.description:
Highlights (must-see places and segments recommended by the community: summits, waterfalls, viewpoints, trails...) in a Komoot region, best first. Each: `id`, `name`, `url`, `type` (point or segment), `sport`, `category`, `categories`, `short_intro`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `altitude_m`, `length_m` (segments), `score`, `editorial`, `image`, `creator` and `raw`. Also `total`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-highlights

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: A region id (from `/komoot/v1/search` results of type `for_region`, or a guide).

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only highlights for this sport (hike, touringbicycle, mtb, racebike, jogging...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Places and regions on Komoot (komoot.com) matching a name, to use with the route and highlight searches. Each result: `name`, `type`, `search_type` (`for_region` results carry a `region_id` for `/komoot/v1/tours` and `/komoot/v1/highlights`; `within_radius` results carry a point and radius), `region_id`, `osm_id`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `radius_km`, `importance`, `city`, `county`, `state`, `country`, `bounds` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place or region name, e.g. `dolomites`, `lake district`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One route on Komoot: a curated smart tour, an editorial tour or a public tour, by id or link. Returns `name`, `kind`, `sport`, `difficulty`, distance, duration, elevation up and down, start point, `rating`, `ratings`, `visitors`, `surfaces` and `way_types` (shares of the route), `highlights_on_route`, `map_image`, `creator`, dates and `raw` (with the route's waypoints `path`, `segments` and `tour_information` such as protected areas and ferries). With `coordinates=true` also the full line as `[longitude, latitude, altitude_m, ms_from_start]` points.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-tour

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A route id (`e2116180501`, `21197`) or a komoot.com/smarttour/... or /tour/... link.

parameters.name: coordinates
parameters.description: true: also return the route's line (adds a few KB to tens of KB).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Routes on Komoot around a point, in a region or through a highlight, with every filter of the discover page: sport, search radius, length, duration, elevation gain, difficulty, route type (loop or out and back), preferred surface, start place (train station, bus stop, car park) and scenery/stop attributes (waterfalls, lakes and rivers, summits, forests, coastline, cafes, mountain huts...). Each route: `id`, `name`, `url`, `kind` (smart tour, editorial tour or public tour), `sport`, `difficulty`, `distance_km`/`_mi`/`_m`, `duration_min`, `elevation_up_m`, `elevation_down_m`, `start`, `rating`, `ratings`, `visitors`, `surfaces`, `way_types` (shares of the route), `highlights_on_route` (highlight ids), `map_image`, `creator` and `raw`. Also `total` and `applied_filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/komoot-tours

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the centre point (with `lng`). Not needed with `region_id` or `highlight_id`.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: A region id (from `/komoot/v1/search` results of type `for_region`, or a guide): routes in that region.

parameters.name: highlight_id
parameters.description: A highlight id: routes that pass that highlight.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: hike (default), mountaineering, jogging, touringbicycle, e_touringbicycle, mtb, e_mtb, mtb_easy, mtb_advanced, racebike, e_racebike, and the site's other sports.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius around the point in km (1-100, default 10).

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: easy, moderate, difficult; comma separated for several.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma separated: waterfalls, lakes_rivers, mountain_summits, forests, coastline, parks, volcanoes, caves, canyons_gorges, cafe, pub, restaurant, mountain_hut, facilities, cultural_historical, climbs, ridges, mountain_passes, bike_parks, avoid_main_roads.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
